name: ZEUS detector
notes: site:desy-hera-south-hall-zeus is owned by the "facilities" lead per the wave-3 id registry and had not been created as of this session; the placement below is a dangling reference, expected until that lead lands its site record.

summary.plain: A large detector at DESY, built around one of the two points on the HERA ring where electrons and protons collided, using a dense uranium calorimeter to measure particle energies very precisely.
summary.technical: General-purpose ep collider detector: high-resolution compensating uranium-scintillator calorimeter, central tracking detector inside a superconducting coil, silicon micro-vertex detector, forward/backward drift-chamber and straw-tube trackers, an instrumented iron absorber for hadronic-shower tails and muon identification, and additional muon detectors covering a large solid angle.

technology.quote: The main detector components are a high-resolution compensating uranium-scintillator calorimeter, a central tracking detector surrounded by a superconducting coil and a silicon micro-vertex detector.
technology.value: Compensating uranium-scintillator calorimeter with central and forward/backward silicon and drift/straw-tube tracking in a superconducting solenoid, plus an instrumented-iron muon system
